facts.label: Contar o que alguém disse sobre algo feito
facts.sub: Para contar uma ação já feita, use said ou told me + passado simples: She said she finished the tests. He told me he was ready.

facts.label: Passado
facts.sub: Para contar algo que já aconteceu, use said + passado simples: She said she finished the tests. O verbo fica no passado: finished, passed, worked. Não adicione s nem ing.

facts.label: Told
facts.sub: Use told + pessoa: My brother told me he finished his project. Depois de told, vem me, you, him, her, us ou them. Said não leva pessoa: She said she finished.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: She said she finished uses the past.
We say “She said she finish yesterday.”
items.why: We say She said she finished.

items.s: “He told me he was ready” is correct.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: She said she finished uses the past. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “She said she finish yesterday.” → Falso (We say She said she finished.)
“He told me he was ready” is correct. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A school yard · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a warm morning at a school in Perth. Students walk into the yard with their bags. Roy waits near the gate. He needs news about the tests. His classmate Zoe talked to the teacher yesterday. Now Roy wants to hear everything.
“Zoe, did you talk to our teacher after class?” says Roy. “Yes. She said she finished the tests last night.” says Zoe. “Really? She told me she was still correcting mine.” says Roy.
